name: privatus-analytics
title: Privatus Analytics
description: Check visitors, top pages, referrers and live visitors for your Privatus Analytics sites without opening a browser.
author: privatusanalytics

commands.name: check-website-stats
commands.title: Check Website Stats
commands.subtitle: Privatus Analytics
commands.description: See visitors, pageviews, bounce rate, top pages, referrers and countries for each of your sites.

commands.name: live-visitors
commands.title: Show Live Visitors
commands.subtitle: Privatus Analytics
commands.description: Show how many people are on your sites right now, in the menu bar.

commands.name: open-dashboard
commands.title: Open Dashboard
commands.subtitle: Privatus Analytics
commands.description: Open your Privatus Analytics dashboard in the browser.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: An API token from Privatus Analytics. Create one under Workspace settings, API tokens. It starts with pat_.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
